text:
Maya Patel: dropping a compact sketch for the Private setup 'Connectivity checks' step. need quick review on copy, a11y, and the suggested actions for failed checks. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example
Alex Chen: quick copy thought: avoid 'open ports' language. propose 'Ensure the following ports are reachable' and add short parentheticals '(443 HTTPS, 2379/2380 etcd)'.
Jordan Lee: accessibility: add aria-live for progress updates, explicit status text for screen readers like 'DNS check: passed' and make sure expand/collapse is keyboard operable (Enter/Space). also chips need >=4.5:1 contrast in both themes.
Samir Rao: ops notes: please include MTU check (VPNs break with jumbo frames) and a concise diagnostic curl users can copy. do NOT provide any remote network changes; only suggested commands and provider console links.
Maya Patel: curl snippets we'd show: `curl -sI https://<control-plane-ip>:443 --max-time 5` and `curl -s http://<node-ip>:2379/health --max-time 5`. label them 'diagnostic only'.
Alex Chen: UI idea: collapse passed checks by default, add a 'Show all checks' toggle, and for each failure show a 1-line reason + 'Why this matters' link to docs. primary CTA: 'Validate & Run' (tooltip: 'Runs quick connectivity and configuration checks required for Private deployments'). secondary: 'Skip & Continue' with confirmation and telemetry when used.
Jordan Lee: visual aids: add icons (check/warn/error) beside chips, and provide a text-only fallback so it doesn't rely on color. ensure focus moves into expanded failure panels and back when closed.
Samir Rao: include copy buttons for diagnostics and example iptables with placeholder CIDRs, e.g. `iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s <control-plane-cidr> --dport 443 -j ACCEPT` and a warning: 'Avoid 0.0.0.0/0; prefer control-plane CIDR.'
InfraBot: preflight lint: success-chip contrast 3.1:1 in dark theme 6a7. Recommend darker fill or white label text.
Maya Patel: action items I will take: 1) update copy to 'Ensure the following ports are reachable' 2) add MTU check + curl examples + iptables snippets (with CIDR warning) 3) collapsed-passed default + 'Show all' toggle 4) chips with icons and improved contrast + aria-live & explicit SR text 5) 'Validate & Run' primary CTA and telemetry on 'Skip & Continue'. I'll push Figma updates and a PR with a11y notes. ping me for a quick pass before merge :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: thanks, will skim the PR and sanity-check microcopy.
Jordan Lee: I'll review keyboard flows and screen reader text once PR is up.
Samir Rao: I'll add cloud console quick links for AWS/GCP/Azure and examples for SG/FW rules.
